objective: Implement the approved Task→manager preparation→safe worktree→host shell run→durable outcome→worker evidence judgment vertical workflow.
required_behavior: Consume only public dependency APIs; preserve stable Task/revision/run linkage and approved scope/proceed authority.
Prepare an execution worktree from an explicit commit using ordinary Git tools without deleting/stashing user changes, bypassing into the development directory, or auto push/merge.
Record cwd, commit, environment, shell acceptance/start/exit-or-unknown, exit status, raw log and result locations durably.

After confirmed exit, produce evidence-backed success/failure/indeterminate judgment covering normal success, nonzero failure, exit-0 criteria failure, and insufficient logs; exit 0 alone is not success.
A worker report requesting code modification ends that instruction; no automatic return after modification without a new manager instruction.
During pause keep exit/log collection but do not start new automated worker analysis.
Classify direct worker requests as existing Task scope, bounded small new spec, or scope expansion; require manager confirmation before expansion execution.
verification: Actual temporary Git repository/worktree and real host shell runtime for all four gate items.
Preparation failures and dirty/untracked source preservation.
Bounded cleanup and no PTY/pipe/process/worktree residue beyond deliberately retained fixture paths.
Relevant dependency regressions and git diff --check.
constraints: Do not commit the shared repository; temporary fixture commits are allowed.
Do not implement automatic worktree lifecycle management beyond the approved guide/preparation seam.
No Phase 2, Docker, push, merge, deploy, reset, clean or stash.
Preserve unrelated dirty/untracked user changes and graphify generated deltas.
report: actual runtime evidence mapped to P-C-AC-03/05/09/11
